name: aloud
description: Aloud — accessible cross-platform read-aloud reader. npm workspace root: @aloud/app (the reading engine), @aloud/aloud-tts (the native module), and example/ (a runnable host app that depends on both as real packages, not copies).

scripts.example:ios: npm run build:core:ios && cd example/ios && bundle exec pod install && cd .. && npm run ios
scripts.example:android: npm run build:core:android && npm run android --workspace=example
